text:
support_jess: FYI NeptunePay complaining of repeated 429s + tail latency spikes on their Dedicated pool since ~09:40 UTC. They're seeing scale up/down loops in our dashboards. ticket #INC-5402

neptune-cs: we started hitting this after our nightly batch kicked off, perf regression only on dedicated-prod-neptune pool, public API v1. Some requests get 200s but many 429s.

mara_sre: putting eyes. can you paste a few request IDs or a short replay payload?

neptune-cs: request ids: r-8f3a, r-8f3b, r-8f7c. payload is a 2k token generation, pushing parallelism x60 for batch job.

liam_oncall: seeing the alert: "dedicated.pool.dyn.scale-flap" triggered 6x in 12m for pool dedicated-prod-neptune. metrics show scale_up -> scale_down every ~90s.

metrics-bot: snapshot: cpu_util median = 72%, cpu_util p95 = 98%, in_flight_requests median = 12, in_flight p95 = 140, scale_events: 7 in 15m.

devops_ale: that looks like noisy spikes from batch causing autoscaler to overreact. what's our current cooldowns for that pool?

eng_platform: config excerpt for pool dedicated-prod-neptune: 
```
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 20
scale_up_threshold: 80
scale_down_threshold: 40
scale_up_cooldown_sec: 60
scale_down_cooldown_sec: 45
stabilization_window_sec: 30
metric: in_flight_requests
```

mara_sre: scale_down_cooldown_sec 45 is dangerously low for bursty workloads. the autoscaler probably scales up on spike then drops back quickly when the batch clears, then next wave triggers up again. classic thrash.

liam_oncall: agree. proposal: increase scale_down_cooldown to 300s, stabilization_window to 180s, and change metric to rolling_median(in_flight, 1m) instead of instantaneous p95. Also add a min_replicas override for that tenant to 6 during night window.

support_jess: if we change min_replicas they'll incur cost. NeptunePay says nightly batch is business-critical; they're okay with temporary bump if we get them stable.

neptune-cs: we'll accept a temporary min_replicas bump. can you do a config change in canary first?

devops_ale: I'll patch canary with these changes now. requesting brief maintenance note to customer.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: autoscaler-config/dedicated-prod-neptune @canary (rev: a1b2c3).

mara_sre: while canary runs, run a small repro to validate oscillation suppression: from our staging k8s exec run: 
```
for i in {1..6}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEPT_TOKEN" -d @batch_payload.json https://dedicated.neptune.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
  sleep 15
done
```
and monitor in_flight and replica_count.

liam_oncall: also add a synthetic constant load test at ~40 rps for 10m to see if scale remains steady.

metrics-bot: canary snapshot (t+5m): scale_events reduced to 1 in 10m, in_flight p95 down to 85, median stable at 18.

devops_ale: rolling the change to prod window 10:50-11:00 UTC if canary stays green.

oncall-pager: quick note — we should also add a noise filter to ignore single-sample spikes above 95th if they clear inside 60s. that plus longer cooldown avoids chasing ephemeral load.

mara_sre: agreed. add config: 
```
spike_suppression:
  window_sec: 60
  percentile_ignore: 95
```

neptune-cs: thanks — after canary we saw 0 user-facing 429s for 12m. can you confirm prod roll?

deploy-bot: prod deploy scheduled. autoscaler-config/dedicated-prod-neptune promoted (rev: a1b2c3 -> prod).

support_jess: pinging customer with rollback plan and cost estimate for min_replicas bump.

liam_oncall: post-deploy, monitor for 30m and check for any unintended capacity plateaus. if we see sustained underutilization for >20m we can trigger a rollback.

mara_sre: follow-up action items: 1) increase scale_down_cooldown_sec to 300 for this pool (done in prod) 2) add stabilization_window_sec 180 3) enable rolling_median metric and spike_suppression 4) add optional night_min_replicas override per-tenant 5) create playbook steps (quick commands) for future noisy-batch tenants.

eng_platform: adding a short playbook snippet to repo: 
```
# quick repro & mitigation
- run parallel batch with curl loop
- adjust pool config: scale_down_cooldown_sec: 300
- set night_min_replicas: 6
- enable spike_suppression window: 60s
- observe for 30m
```

neptune-cs: confirmed stabilized for us, thanks team. appreciate the quick turnaround.

mara_sre: marking INC-5402 resolved pending 1h of clean metrics. I'll file a postmortem note on root cause = noisy nightly batch + aggressive cooldowns.

oncall-pager: reminder: follow-up ticket to instrument per-tenant batch detection signal so autoscaler can treat scheduled spikes differently.

support_jess: customer update sent. closing loop in 10m if no regressions. :white_check_mark:

eng_platform: FYI we should consider a global autoscaler tuning doc for dedicated pools to avoid repeating this.

mara_sre: thanks all. nice teamwork. :raised_hands:
